events.title: Trellis Banking API: product deep dive

lines.speaker: Meera Iyer
lines.text: Abhishek, thanks for walking us through the model.

lines.speaker: Abhishek Joshi
lines.text: Happy to. Two issuers are live and false positives are down forty percent.

lines.speaker: Meera Iyer
lines.text: I'll send the reference questions by Thursday so you can brief your customers.

lines.speaker: Abhishek Joshi
lines.text: Great. I'll share the fraud loss benchmarks by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Abhishek Joshi
lines.text: If you're in, we'd love you to take your full pro rata next round.

lines.speaker: Abhishek Joshi
lines.text: I'll also intro you to our design partner at the bank.

lines.speaker: Meera Iyer
lines.text: Thank you, talk soon.

lines.text: Neha, thanks for the deep dive.

lines.text: I'll send the API documentation by Tuesday.

lines.speaker: Meera Iyer
lines.text: And I'll share our view on your pricing by next week.

lines.speaker: Neha Kulkarni
lines.text: We should catch up with your partner sometime.

lines.text: I'll get you two bank CTO references by the end of the month.

lines.text: Great, thank you.

lines.text: Omkar, thanks for the overview of the cross-border rails.

lines.text: I'll give you data room access by Monday.

lines.speaker: Meera Iyer
lines.text: And I'll come back with feedback after our Monday partner meeting.

lines.speaker: Omkar Patil
lines.text: Great.

lines.text: Shreya, thanks for the follow-up.

lines.speaker: Meera Iyer
lines.text: And I'll confirm the second meeting slot by Friday.

lines.text: Great.

lines.text: Leena, thanks for coming in.

lines.text: If we raise a bridge, it would be small.

lines.text: I'll send the BNPL partner contracts summary by next Tuesday.
